title: functions.executions.response.unary.VectorCompletionTask
description:
A complete vector completion response (non-streaming).

Contains the final scores, all votes from the ensemble, and the underlying
agent completions that produced those votes.

completions.description: The underlying agent completions from each agent in the ensemble.

created.description: Unix timestamp when the completion was created.

ensemble.description: ID of the ensemble used for this completion.

id.description: Unique identifier for this vector completion.

scores.description: Final weighted scores for each response option. Sums to 1.

usage.description: Aggregated token and cost usage across all completions.

votes.description: Individual votes from each agent, showing their selections.

weights.description:
Total weight allocated to each response option. Same length as `scores`.
For discrete votes, an LLM's full weight goes to its selected response.
For probabilistic votes, the weight is divided according to the distribution.
